testRun.output: Both BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 188 repo-wide at that point.

implementation.summary: Drag state lives in composable remember, NEVER in Orbit - the reducer sees exactly one pass per gesture, at release, gated on isMeaningfulDrag. Guides are the kit's horizontal Ruler plus the same Ruler rotated 270 degrees, both fed device pixels.

troubleshooting.issue: pointerInput(Unit) would capture a stale FrameGeometry (framePx is Size.Zero on first composition).
troubleshooting.resolution: geometry and onIntent read through rememberUpdatedState inside the release handler. Without this the drag layer silently stages a zero rect.

troubleshooting.issue: The two ruler strips overlap in the top-left corner square.
troubleshooting.resolution: Insetting either would make its scale stop matching the frame it measures - roughly 3% error on a 700dp stage - which is the worse bug. Overlap is deliberate and documented.

needsHumanReview.reason: Needs one rendered pass. This host cannot load Skiko in-process (ImageBitmap(2,3) throws LibraryLoadException) and the repo has no Compose UI-test harness, so nothing visual is asserted by a test.
